texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Why Base? What got you interested?: I build in-real-life community for a living, and I know how rare it is to get it right. In 2023 I founded the Palo Alto AI Research Lab and grew it to 500+ practitioners - Stanford researchers, big-tech engineers - through regular in-person gatherings; before that I ran a startup incubator for 11 years where cohorts, events and advisor matchmaking were the product. What [человек] me in this posting: Base treats partnerships as the product itself - 'the table nobody else gets' - not a sponsorship spreadsheet. That is how I have always run rooms: the right partner elevates the room, the wrong one cheapens it. Building that portfolio from zero, with a revenue number on it, is the job I want. (US work eligibility: active O-1, no sponsorship needed.)
texts.Tell us about a time you were relentless: Raising our $35M fund and syndicate with no brand and no warm market. I turned fundraising into an assembly line: 2,000+ institutional-investor calls I qualified and enriched myself, a CRM I wrote from scratch when nothing off the shelf fit (roots: 5 years building ERP/CRM on Salesforce and Navision at Merlion), and lead-to-call pipelines that up to 30 operators ran daily. When people stopped scaling, I automated the repeatable motions - enrichment, matching, follow-up cadences - first with scripts, today with AI agents. Result: a standing syndicate of 250 VCs/angels and $35M under management. The lesson I bring to partnerships: resourcefulness is not heroics, it is refusing to accept that a bottleneck is permanent.
texts.Who is your dream dinner guest?: [человек] Karpathy - I run my whole operation on AI agents and document it in public, and I'd love to compare notes on what daily life inside 'software 3.0' actually looks like.
